summary: VERDICT: FALSE (78% confidence). The British TV presenter Christopher James Evans (born 1 April 1966) has never been credited as playing Captain America in any Marvel film; his notable presenting roles include The One Show, Radio 2 Live in Hyde Park, TFI Friday revival, Top Gear, and Virgin Radio UK breakfast show.

findings.statement: Christopher James Evans, born 1 April 1966, is an English television presenter, radio DJ, and producer.

He has presented The One Show on Fridays between 2010 and 2015, co-hosted Radio 2 Live in Hyde Park between 2011 and 2018, presented a revival series of TFI Friday after signing a three-year Top Gear deal in 2015, stepped down as Top Gear presenter in July 2016, and moved to Virgin Radio UK to present its breakfast show in September 2018.
Chris Evans, the British TV presenter, has never been credited as playing Captain America in any Marvel Studios film.
